topology_reasoning.device: A compact nested-loop resonator / resonant routing cell: an outer oval loop encloses a smaller, pointed oval loop, while mirrored upper and lower double-aperture sections locally load and couple the inner loop.
topology_reasoning.operation: Light circulating in the outer and inner closed paths experiences coupled resonances; the mirrored aperture sections provide the two localized interaction regions, so their gaps and path lengths determine the resonant response.
topology_reasoning.observed_geometry: The calibrated 3.0 um by 5.5 um drawing is one connected material region with an outer elliptical track, a central angular loop, two mirrored rectangular double-aperture blocks, and six enclosed voids. The raster is anisotropically scaled by the supplied calibration, so dimensions are specified in physical microns rather than image aspect ratio.

iterations.change_made: Initial construction: elliptical outer loop, closed faceted inner loop, and two boolean double-aperture blocks. The comparison showed that the target outer contour is substantially flatter at the poles and that the closed inner loop incorrectly filled the four aperture voids.

Changed the outer path to a superellipse and split the inner trace into left/right faceted connectors, preserving all four aperture voids. This improved fidelity but the central void remained incorrectly connected to the upper and lower annular voids.

Tested a lower-power outer superellipse and moved the inner-path contacts into the aperture blocks to force closure. It overfilled the central routing region and worsened IoU, so this topology adjustment is rejected.
Tested a manually knot-fitted outer contour. Its path offset changed the calibrated footprint height and overfilled the shoulder regions, so it is rejected in favor of the iteration-2 superellipse.
Restored the iteration-2 superelliptical outer path and original side-connector contacts. This is the honest best result after five comparisons.
Added the live phase-trim measurement contract along an existing upper rail and reran the final permitted comparison. It preserves the same rendered geometry and calibrated footprint.

knob_response.note: The phase-trim path is integrated in the upper aperture rail at the target setting and extends physical layer-(1,0) geometry when delta_length is increased.
